classification.analysis: GSD was a lightweight meta-prompting, context-engineering and spec-driven-development system for Claude Code, providing structured phase/plan/milestone workflows via slash commands and hooks. The repository is now archived and its README simply redirects users to the successor project 'GSD Core' at open-gsd/gsd-core, where active development continues. Kept only as a historical pointer; not usable or maintained in its current form.
